canonical_definition: BoolQ is a binary yes/no question answering benchmark primarily used to evaluate reading comprehension and commonsense reasoning capabilities in language models. It typically involves answering questions requiring factual or inferential understanding of textual passages, with some variants framed as open-/closed-book QA or focusing on specific subsets like balanced samples. The task is often included in multi-task evaluation suites to assess LLMs' ability to handle straightforward factual queries and logical deduction.
